_doc: References the generic probe could not resolve, classified after a deliberately unfiltered DOM scan (scripts/probe-nav.mjs) at rest AND after scrolling 900px. The scan ignores tag and class entirely and accepts any visible element near the top that contains a link, so a nil result is evidence of absence rather than a heuristic failure.

noInspectableNavbar._note: No navigation container exists in the DOM at 1440x900, at rest or after scroll. These sites draw their interface in WebGL/canvas or present no persistent bar on the homepage. They are NOT reconstructed: there is nothing to measure, and inventing one would be fabrication.

akqa.detail: Nil at rest and after scroll. evidence/akqa/probe-top.png and probe-scrolled.png show full-bleed type with no bar.

activetheory.detail: Nil at rest and after scroll; the interface is WebGL-rendered.

resn.detail: Nil at rest and after scroll; WebGL-rendered.

immersivegarden.detail: Nil at rest and after scroll; WebGL-rendered.

caffedesign.detail: Nil at rest and after scroll.

breel.detail: Only a 400x213 'GET IN TOUCH' callout after scroll; no navigation bar.

buildinamsterdam.detail: Only a 202x80 header carrying a single link and no navigation items.

brunosimon.detail: A WebGL driving game; the screenshot pass timed out against its continuous render loop and no DOM navigation exists.

recoverableWithSelector._note: A navigation container DOES exist; the generic scorer missed it. Each entry names the selector the diagnostic found, so these can be reconstructed.

koto.detail: Three separate floating groups inset 16px, each 48px tall: brand+toggle at 151x48@16,16; nav at 452x48@132,16 (Work|About|Services|Latest|Careers|Contact); a city list at 370x48@1428,16 with backdrop blur. The nav group translates left on scroll (x=132 to x=-123).

griflan.detail: 1440x36 fixed z=100 with 10 links, plus a separate 324x52 action group at y=36 below the bar.

gardeneight.detail: 351x90@920,0 with six links (Home|Cases|About|Archives|Contact|AI), revealed after scroll.

monks.detail: 1440x100@0,110 with 30 links. At rest it sits behind a language-selection overlay (div.fixed-wrapper, English/Spanish/Portuguese) which the generic dismiss patterns do not match; that overlay is what the first sweep measured.
